title: Guild to Hell: The Road to Hell Is Paved with Good Requirements
author: McSloth
blurb:
Walter Dunleavy died at 3:12 a.m. on a Friday, pushing a "quick hotfix" to production. He'd hoped for a cheat skill, a harem, or at least a nap. Instead, the overworked goddess of reincarnation filed him under the default template, and he woke up at the gates of the Grand Consolidated Adventurers' Guild of Waterfell: seven managers per adventurer, a quest backlog that is literally a bottomless pit, and a Guildmaster who pivots strategy whenever he sees a nice banner.

His skill, [True Estimate], tells him the King's "30-day" dragon quest will take nine months. Nobody wants to hear it. Now Walter has to lead a party of misfits through scope creep, curse debt, consultants and a Friday launch — without dying of overwork a second time.
